name: Two-Stage Photometric and Perceptual Training Strategy
aliases: Multi-view and Voxel Transformer Joint Fine-tuning
definition: A two-stage training strategy for the SplatVoxel feed-forward networks using photometric loss.
summary: This strategy stabilizes feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting by decoupling training into multi-view backbone optimization and joint voxel fine-tuning, using distinct perceptual weights to balance structural consistency and detail refinement.
